rows.heading: Trading Mentor — Curated Knowledge
rows.mentorText:
Smart Trading Mentor
Trading Mentor — Curated Knowledge

Educational answers — strategy, risk, psychology, technicals

Hey! I'm your Smart Mentor — a curated trading-knowledge engine built from real strategy, risk, and psychology lessons. Ask me anything about trading, or tap a topic below.

Explain RSI

Built-in educational response:

RSI is a momentum oscillator scaled 0–100 measuring speed and change of price moves.

• >70 = overbought (potential pullback)
• <30 = oversold (potential bounce)
• 50 = neutral / trend reset

Reality check: RSI alone is not a buy/sell signal. In strong trends, RSI can stay overbought (or oversold) for weeks. Use it with price action, volume, and support/resistance — not as a standalone trigger.

(Educational simulation only — not financial advice.)
